07-11-1295 is November 7, 1295.  
Add 22 days:  
November has 30 days, so from Nov 7: 30 - 7 = 23 days left in November.  
22 days added uses all 23 days of November? No: 22 - 23 = -1 → actually 22 days from Nov 7 = Nov 7 + 22 = Nov 29.  
Check: Nov 7 + 22 = Nov 29 (since 7+22=29).  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1295-11-29
